top rclive_tb.shbench for Ngspice
== analogLib/cap.shprim
schemify 1 shprim
  provenance "virtuoso analogLib/cap"
  vibox -40 -40 40 40
  vsym e876d010f92213f6

pin PLUS inout 0 0
  vplabel 0 0 R0 centerLeft stick 10000
pin MINUS inout 0 60
  vplabel 0 0 R0 centerLeft stick 10000

param c ""
  kind string
param m ""
  kind string

impl spice spice
  format spice "C{name} {PLUS} {MINUS} {c}{m != \"\" ? \" m=\" + m : \"\"}"
  format spectre "{name} ({PLUS} {MINUS}) cap"

rect -20 -20 20 20

stext 0 -30 R0 {name}
  size 1
  vlabel annotate drawing7 lowerLeft stick IL cdsName() {name}

  kind string

  kind string

  kind string

  kind string

  kind string

  kind string
param per ""
  kind string
param vdc ""
  kind string
param acm ""
  kind string
param acp ""
  kind string

impl spice spice
  format spice "V{name} {PLUS} {MINUS} pulse({v1} {v2} {td} {tr} {tf} {pw} {per})"
  format spectre "{name} ({PLUS} {MINUS}) vpulse"

rect -20 -20 20 20

  size 1
  vlabel annotate drawing7 lowerLeft stick IL cdsName() {name}
== rcfilter.shcomp
schemify 1 shcomp
  doc "RC low-pass section: R from in to out, C from out to gnd (live Virtuoso kit fixture)"
  prefix X
  vsym a8a2064e8dda732f
  vsch f446799ed13dc48f
  vcdf abd87641e9723a8a
  vcdfrec "(\"cdf\" \"\")"
  vcdfrec "(\"param\" \"R\" \"string\" \"1k\" \"R\" \"resistance\" (\"parseAsNumber\" \"parseAsCEL\") () \"\")"
  vcdfrec "(\"param\" \"C\" \"string\" \"1u\" \"C\" \"capacitance\" (\"parseAsNumber\" \"parseAsCEL\") () \"\")"
  vcdfrec "(\"siminfo\" \"auCdl\" ((\"instParameters\" (\"R\" \"C\")) (\"namePrefix\" \"X\") (\"netlistProcedure\" \"ansCdlSubcktCall\") (\"termOrder\" (\"in\" \"out\" \"gnd\"))))"
  vcdfrec "(\"siminfo\" \"spectre\" ((\"instParameters\" (\"R\" \"C\")) (\"termOrder\" (\"in\" \"out\" \"gnd\"))))"

pin in in -40 0
pin out out 40 0
pin gnd inout 0 40

param R 1k
  unit Ohm
param C 1u
  unit F

impl sch schematic

rect -20 -20 20 20

line -40 0 -20 0
line 20 0 40 0
line 0 20 0 40

stext -20 -28 R0 {name}
  size 0.2
stext -14 -5 R0 rc
  size 0.18

inst c00001 core:cap
  at 0 90 R0
  name C1
  value C
inst r00001 core:res
  at 0 0 R0
  name R1
  value R

wire w00001 -60 -30 0 -30
wire w00002 0 30 0 60
wire w00003 0 30 60 30
wire w00004 0 120 0 150

port p00001 -60 -30 R0 in
port p00002 60 30 R180 out
port p00003 0 150 R270 gnd
== rclive_tb.shbench

  name V1

  at 0 0 R0
  name X1
  R R
  C C

wire w00001 -120 0 -40 0
wire w00002 -120 60 -120 80
wire w00003 0 40 0 80
wire w00004 -120 80 0 80
wire w00005 40 0 80 0

label n00001 80 0 R0 out
label n00002 -80 0 R0 in
label n00003 -60 80 R0 0

var R 1k
  unit Ohm
var C 1u
  unit F

output tau "cross(v(out), 0.6321205588285577)"
output v1m "at(v(out), 1m)"

spec v1m
  min 0.5
  max 0.8

code tran spice
  | .tran 1u 5m
